name: How long does the framing phase take for a small room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does the framing phase take for a small room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing a typical small addition (such as a 150 to 400 square foot room extension) usually takes 3 to 7 working days, depending on weather and roof complexity. The full framing phase begins once the foundation or slab is cured and ready. If the design includes custom ceiling details, complex roof tie-ins, or large structural openings through existing exterior brick or siding, framing can take slightly longer. After framing completes, sub-trades run rough plumbing and electrical wiring before our crew returns to install insulation and hang drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing a small addition typically takes 3 to 7 working days once the foundation is ready, depending on weather, roof tie-in complexity, and opening sizes.
